name: How long does a professional drywall repair take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a professional drywall repair take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most minor drywall repairs take one to two days to complete properly. While patching a small hole or applying joint compound takes relatively little physical time, each coat of mud must dry completely before sanding and applying the next coat. Deep patches or repairs requiring multiple compound coats often need overnight drying, especially in Colorado where humidity levels fluctuate. If the repair also includes texture matching and final interior painting, scheduling across two consecutive visits ensures the compound fully cures and the painted finish blends seamlessly into the surrounding wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most drywall repairs take one to two days. Compound coats must dry fully before sanding, texturing, and interior painting can be completed.
